Figure 1. Biosynthetic gene clusters and the proposed biosynthetic pathways of ABX and FAS. (A) The biosynthetic gene clusters. (B) The
proposed biosynthetic pathway of FAS and (−)-ABX as well as formicapyridine A. Spon. indicates spontaneous.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. UPLC analysis of the in vitro enzymatic reactions to
investigate the function of FasS (detection wavelength λ = 365 nm).
(I) Compound 1 was biosynthesized by combining the minimal PKS
(FabD, FasAB, and FasC), MatB, cofactor SAM, and CYC/AROs
(Abx(+)C, D) with MT (Abx(+)M) at 12 °C for 12 h. Subsequently,
the compound 1-producing reaction mixture underwent spontaneous
decarboxylation at 12 °C for 12 h as a control experiment. (II)
Spontaneous decarboxylation of the compound 1-producing reaction
mixture was assessed at 30 °C for 12 h in a separate control
experiment. (III) After completion of the compound 1-producing
reaction, FasS was added to evaluate its carboxyl protection ability,
incubated at 30 °C for 12 h. (IV) Using compound 1 as the substrate,
FasU was added to produce FAS, incubated at 30 °C for 12 h. (V)
Using compound 1 as the substrate, FasS and FasU were added to
produce FAS, incubated at 30 °C for 12 h. (VI) FAS standard. (VII)
PDA standard.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. Characterization of AbxO. (A) UPLC analysis of the activity of Abx(+)O and Abx(−)O on 1 (detection wavelength λ = 365 nm). (I)
Compound 1 was biosynthesized by combining the minimal PKS (FabD, FasAB, and FasC), MatB, cofactor SAM, and CYC/AROs (Abx(+)C, D)
with MT (Abx(+)M) at 12 °C for 12 h. Subsequently, the compound 1-producing reaction mixture underwent spontaneous decarboxylation at 12
°C for 12 h as a control experiment. (II−V) After completion of the compound 1-producing reaction, Abx(+)O, Abx(−)O, FasS, and FasU were
selectively introduced into the 1-producing reaction system according to the indication in each trace and coincubated at 12 °C for 12 h. (VI) FAS
standard. (VII) PDA standard. (B) UPLC analysis of extracts from the recombinant strains of S. coelicolor M1154 (detection wavelength λ = 365
nm). (I) M1154 with 4E10, which contains the BGC of (−)-ABX. Peaks with an asterisk are (−)-ABXs analogs. (II) M1154 with abx(−)O-deleted
4E10. (III) M1154 wild-type strain (control). (IV) (−)-ABX standard. (V) FAS-F standard. Spon. indicates spontaneous.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 4. Crystal structures of AccS, Abx(+)O, and WhiE-ORFI and their substrate binding and catalytic mechanism. (A) The apo structure of AccS
(PDB 9LMM). (B) The apo structure of Abx(+)O (PDB 9LTX). (C) AccS docking with 1 and optimized by MD simulation. Hydrogen bonds
between residues and the substrate are indicated by dark dashed lines. (D) Abx(+)O docking with 1. (E) The apo structure of WhiE-ORFI (PDB
9LMN). (F) Superposition of WhiE-ORFI (palegreen), AccS (bluewhite), and Abx(+)O (wheat). (G) The relative activity of carboxyl-protecting
proteins, including FasS, AccS, AccS mutants, WhiE-ORFI, WhiE-ORFI-Nt, and the WhiE-ORFI-Nt mutant. (H) The relative activity of
decarboxylases, including Abx(+)O, Abx(+)O, and WhiE-ORFI-Ct.
